evidence.claim: Ethypharm produce farmaci per sistema nervoso centrale, dolore severo e dipendenze, con 6 siti produttivi tra Regno Unito, Francia, Spagna e Cina.
evidence.quote: Ethypharm is a specialty pharmaceutical company providing essential medicines in Central Nervous System (CNS), specifically for severe pain and addiction, as well as in Internal Medicines. || 6 manufacturing sites in the UK, France (2) , Spain (2) & in China. || The Group also offers a wide range of injectable medicines for hospitals and emergency situations.
